state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 5 (the fixes).** Stage 4's review is whole (`docs/perf/performance-review.md`).

**The workspace index lookups are fixed and measured.** `crates/nvs-lsp/src/index.rs` keeps three name maps (declaration, subtypes, uses), and the override walks use a seen set. Every `lsp` ladder now also asks for code lenses (`tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` `lspScript`). New ladder `benches/scaling/lsp/hierarchy.nvs`. CodeLens at 3200 subclasses: 178 ms before, 39 ms after (`docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What got better*). Its gap record is deleted.

**`lsp/hierarchy.nvs` still grows** (clock slope about 1.6): open, completion, hover and references grow about 3× per doubling in both builds, only on a file with `extends`. `nvs check` of the same file is linear. Recorded in `data/gaps/nvs-lsp/a-request-on-a-file-of-subclasses-grows-faster-than-linear.json`, with the per-request figures.

**8 gap records owned by `performance-pass`** keep `owners --closes performance-pass` red (`bun nv owners --closes performance-pass` lists them).

**`bun nv scaling --check` is red on three ladders:** `numbers/bigint-mul.nvs` unclear, `request/headers.nvs` invalid (a `serve` ladder does not run under callgrind), and `lsp/hierarchy.nvs` grows.

items.text: **Find and fix what grows faster than linear when `nvs lsp` analyses a file of n subclasses** (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/document.rs:568`, `crates/nvs-lsp/src/server.rs:1228`), per `data/gaps/nvs-lsp/a-request-on-a-file-of-subclasses-grows-faster-than-linear.json`. Generate the ladder's document at 800, 1600 and 3200 classes and time each request in one session (`lspScript` and `lspFrame` from `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts` give the messages). Hover growing 3× per doubling means the work is per request, not only on open. Then take the before and after, write them to `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What got better*, delete the gap record, and confirm `bun nv scaling lsp/` is flat. Rule: AGENTS.md priority ordering.

**Judge the two other ladders that keep `scaling --check` red** (`benches/scaling/numbers/bigint-mul.nvs:1`, `benches/scaling/request/headers.nvs:1`): re-run each, and either fix the ladder or write it under `docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *Benches to look at*. Rule: `benches/scaling/README.md`.
